extDescription.message: Turn every Like button on the web into a full emoji palette.

settingEnabledHint.message: Master switch for all supported sites

settingReplaceNativeHint.message: Hide Star/Like in favor of the picker

settingAnimationsHint.message: Show emoji bursts when counts appear or you react

settingThemeHint.message: Follow the browser, or always use light or dark

settingAutoTriggerHint.message: Mirror your emoji to the site's Like/Dislike

sentimentIntro.message: Drag an emoji between lists, or tap it and then tap a list.

sectionPerSiteHint.message: Choose which sites show the picker

signInMsgAccount.message: Sign in to manage your account.

signInMsgHistory.message: Sign in to view your reactions history.

signInMsgReport.message: Sign in to submit a bug report.

deleteAccountConfirm.message:
Delete your Emojery account?

This action is permanent and cannot be undone. Your user record will be erased and the counters for every reaction you previously submitted will be decremented.

deleteAccountProgress.message: Deleting your account... please don't close this window.

historyEmpty.message: No reactions yet. Click an emoji on any supported page!

importError.message: That file isn't a valid Emojery export.

importReplaceWarn.message: Importing replaces your current history with this file. This can't be undone.

reportUnsupportedPage.message: Please open the page where reactions aren't working, then open this menu again to report it.

pickerKeyboardHint.message: Use the arrow keys to move between emoji, Enter to react, Escape to close.

authSignInTagline.message: Sign in with an account you already have, using any service below.

authSigningInKeepOpen.message: Keep this tab open until it finishes. The first sign-in takes a little longer.

authFactPublic.message: What's public: your reactions, under a pseudonym — permanently; independent archives may keep copies even after we delete ours.

authFactNotPublic.message: What's not: your name, email, IP.

authFactSensitive.message: Reactions to political or religious posts can reveal your views.

authPersonalOnly.message: Work or school accounts aren't supported — use a personal Google or Microsoft account.

authSeparateAccounts.message: Signing in with a different provider creates a separate account with its own reactions and history.

authAgreeTerms.message: I accept the Terms of Use and confirm I am 16 or older.

authAgreePublicLog.message: I agree that every reaction I make is published to anyone, permanently, in Emojery's public log under my pseudonym — including reactions that may reveal my political, religious or other views or my health.

authObjectAnyTime.message: You can object at any time to our use of your data for the public log and anti-abuse — see Privacy Policy › Your rights. Deleting your account is the quickest way.

authDeletionNote.message: If you delete your account, we remove your reactions from the counts; entries already published stay in the log under your pseudonym.

authDoneTagline.message: You can close this tab and react on any supported page.

authDoneReturnTagline.message: Taking you back to the page you were on.

dataConsentBody.message: Emojery sends the site and the ID of the post you react on, your reaction, and a one-time sign-in token from the provider you choose; your name and email are not requested. Reactions are published permanently in a public log under a pseudonym, and the country and network of each vote are kept for 30 days to fight abuse.

authErrUnknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

authErrCancelled.message: Sign-in was cancelled. Try again when you're ready.

authErrProviderDenied.message: The provider did not complete the sign-in. Try again or choose another account.

authErrAccountTypeUnsupported.message: Work and school accounts can't sign in. Use a personal account instead.

authErrEnrollFailed.message: Could not register your account right now. Please try again in a minute.

authErrOutdated.message: This version of Emojery is out of date. Update it to sign in.

clientOutdatedNotice.message: This version of Emojery is out of date. Update it to vote and sign in again.

authErrDeviceLimit.message: This account has added as many new devices as it can today. Try again after midnight UTC.

loadError.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errOffline.message: You appear to be offline. Try again once you reconnect.

errRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errServerBusy.message: The server is having trouble. Try again in a minute.

reportSendError.message: Could not send the report. Check your connection and try again.

onboardingTagline.message: React to posts, videos and products with any emoji.

onboardingStepPinBody.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon {icon} in the toolbar and pin Emojery so it stays in reach.

onboardingStepPinBodyOpera.message: Click the extensions icon {icon} in the toolbar and pin Emojery so it stays in reach.

onboardingStepSpotBody.message: A small emoji button appears next to Like, Star or Share on supported pages.

onboardingStepReactBody.message: Pick any emoji you like. Counts are public. Sign in once at your first reaction, then just react.

gateBody.message: Sign in with an account you already have to make your reaction count.

coachBody.message: One click to see the community's reactions and pick yours from an unlimited emoji palette.

voteDailyLimit.message: Today's reaction limit is reached. Voting resumes at $TIME$.
